facts.detail: Ofcom published the Nations report 2025 on 19 November 2025.
Around 26,000 premises in England could not access decent fixed or FWA broadband.
The England count was 7,000 lower than the previous year.
Northern Ireland had 95% residential full-fibre availability.
Northern Ireland full-fibre take-up was 62% where available.
Scotland full-fibre availability reached 71% of residential properties.
Scotland full-fibre take-up rose to 43%.
Wales full-fibre availability reached 78% of residential premises.
Wales full-fibre take-up rose to 49%.
Around 6,000 premises in Wales could not access decent fixed or FWA broadband.
